Place the rigid coolant supply pipe to the engine oil heat exchanger back in its housing, connect to the thermostat and fasten it using the bolts.

Place the gasket in its housing.

Connect the rigid delivery pipe for the engine oil heat exchanger, heat exchanger side, and secure with bolts.
